resolved_findings.title: Link the lower-limit boundary condition to its actual definition
resolved_findings.finding: The theorem selects its unique carrier by liminf as n tends to minus infinity, but neither defines liminf nor links to a definition. Its current box-ball prerequisite destinations 4C13, 4C14 and 4C15 do not define it. The site's declared baseline is elementary sets and arithmetic, not analysis terminology.
resolved_findings.correction: Link the lower-limit terminology to the already existing 0F61, with a brief indication that the left-hand limit is the ordinary limit of W_{-k}. The sup/inf definition can use 0A37. Do not create duplicate definitions.
resolved_findings.acceptance_condition: Re-read the changed note and verify that its actual destinations decode both the boundary condition and the infinite extrema.
resolved_findings.resolution: 4K01 links sup to 0A37 and liminf to 0F61, explicitly interpreting the left limit through W_{-k}. Both actual destinations were read. The theorem and proof remain valid.

resolved_findings.title: Restrict conditional-probability ratios to positive-probability histories
resolved_findings.finding: The phrase 'any finite past' and P(A|B)=P(A intersect B)/P(B) omit P(B)>0. This matters in an explicitly allowed boundary case: when p1=0, histories containing adjacent 1s have probability zero.
resolved_findings.correction: State the Markov conditional-probability rule only for finite histories of positive probability, and put P(B)>0 next to the displayed ratio. The cylinder-probability construction and the invariant-law theorem can otherwise remain unchanged.
resolved_findings.acceptance_condition: The zero-probability qualification appears locally, while p1=0 remains allowed.
resolved_findings.resolution: 4K0B now restricts the Markov rule to positive-probability finite histories and explicitly requires P(B)>0 for its ratio. The allowed p1=0 case is retained.

resolved_findings.title: The probability-density link does not define a density
resolved_findings.finding: The link labelled probability density leads to 00L0. That page defines a real random variable, its push-forward distribution and discrete point masses; it gives no density definition. Thus the continuous-density calculations begin with an unresolved foundational term.
resolved_findings.correction: Supply the short local contract P(X in A)=integral_A f(x) dx with f nonnegative and integral f=1, linking Lebesgue measure/integration as needed; or reuse a genuinely suitable canonical density definition. Do not link to 4401 merely by its title: its setting is particle phase space, although its first paragraph was inspected as a possible reusable formulation.
resolved_findings.acceptance_condition: The labelled destination actually defines the term, or the local definition makes the link unnecessary; recheck the subsequent exponential/Gamma/GIG density usage.
resolved_findings.resolution: 4K0M now defines probability density via Borel-set probabilities, nonnegativity and normalization, with genuine Lebesgue measure/integration destinations 00XV and 00Q5. The incorrect label to 00L0 is gone.

resolved_findings.title: Gamma densities need not have a positive power at zero
resolved_findings.finding: The logarithmic-integrability argument says the Gamma density has a positive power at zero. A shape a in (0,1) is allowed, and then its leading factor is x^{a-1} with a negative exponent. The claimed logarithmic integrability and positive drift are true, but the stated reason excludes part of the theorem's parameter range.
resolved_findings.counterexample: For a=1/2, the density behaves as a positive constant times x^{-1/2} near zero.
resolved_findings.correction: Use exponent a-1>-1 and show integral_0^1 x^{a-1}|log x| dx=1/a^2<infinity (or the equivalent substitution x=e^{-u}); exponential decay handles infinity. Apply the same reasoning to shape a+b.
resolved_findings.acceptance_condition: The local proof covers every a,b,c>0 without claiming boundedness or vanishing of the density at zero.
resolved_findings.resolution: 4K0P now uses r-1>-1 and the exact integral integral_0^1 x^(r-1)|log x| dx=1/r^2 for every r>0, then applies it to a and a+b. This covers shapes below one and validates the strict logarithmic drift.

resolved_findings.correction: Use survey Section 5.3 for this material and preserve the specific original-paper locators. Apply the same correction to the eventual packet's claim-source and actual-reading entries only for locations the writer actually inspected.

resolved_findings.title: Explain or remove the specialized terms in the outline's closing paragraph
resolved_findings.finding: The closing paragraph introduces quadrirational maps, generalized Gibbs equilibrium states and local relaxation without a local explanation or a definition destination. These are not in the site's elementary baseline, and NOTES_STYLE_GUIDE requires an outline's first specialist terminology to be understandable without outsourcing the whole paragraph to links.
resolved_findings.correction: Remove the unneeded terminology list, or give concise plain-language meanings and genuine existing prerequisite destinations where available. Keep local generalized Gibbs states and relaxation framed as research questions; the survey's Section 7 does not provide an established general construction.
resolved_findings.acceptance_condition: The final paragraph can be understood without prior knowledge of these three specialist terms; do not create duplicate definitions just to support an optional coda.
resolved_findings.resolution: 4K00 replaces the unexplained closing terminology list with plain-language local-window equilibrium and microscopic-to-macroscopic questions, without turning open questions into established results.

resolved_findings.title: Connect the GIG density definition to the existing probability-density contract
resolved_findings.finding: 4K0Q defines its law by a probability density but neither explains that term nor links to its definition. Its registered prerequisites are only 00L0 and 0H4Z; the actual pages and their full declared prerequisite closure define random variables/distributions and Gamma integration, not the density contract. The now-correct local contract in 4K0M is unreachable from this note's prerequisite graph. A graph with no missing targets or cycles therefore still leaves this non-elementary term hidden.

Add 4K0M to prerequisites[4K0Q] and the corresponding entries record, refresh the owned-note hash and validation counts, then report the new frozen packet hash. additional_checks.detail: Checked the integer-supremum attainment argument, minimality and uniqueness from left-unbounded zeroes, normalized future-minimum inverse, reflection sign, unequal left/right positive slopes, and the explicit lost-ball example. SA-F01 is resolved by the actual extrema/lower-limit destinations. The minus sign in the path reflection is correct even though the survey HTML's accompanying sentence omits it.

Checked the two-sided orthogonal-partial-sum argument through 0HS1 and 0HS0, geometric normalization and moments through 4E05, past/future independence, adjacent-level flux balance, finite-row induction and cylinder-law uniqueness. The finite-row proof does not assume global stationarity circularly.

The Markov range, including p1=0, matches Theorem 1.8(b) and Section 3.2.2. The newly supplied local Burke proof was checked: recover W_0^0 from the new right half-path, separate it from the new left half-path and all future loads, then use temporal stationarity and finite induction. The geometric moments are correct. SA-F02 is resolved by explicit positive-probability qualifications.

Checked midpoint extrema/log-sums, tail convergence and two-sided slopes, KdV carrier factors, uniform epsilon log(2) error, Toda three-variable maps, alternating encoding, odd-indexed carriers and the one-site shift. The local limit is not claimed to imply an infinite-orbit limit.

Checked the four model-specific existence/uniqueness statements and their path encoding against the source, and checked that the local-balance equivalence retains the full-measure global-uniqueness assumption. These external research proofs were not independently reconstructed.

Checked the exponential, Beta-Gamma, Toda and GIG calculations directly, including density factors, parameter ranges, area preservation and global drift assumptions. SA-F03, SA-F04, SA-F05 and SA-F07 are resolved. The GIG density definition now reaches the genuine probability-density contract in 4K0M and its measure/integration destinations.

The fixed-total-particle fiber is the stated integer interval, the update reflects its x coordinate, and every point on that fiber has the same product-law mass. The J=1, K-to-infinity local limit is correctly separated from global existence.

All 33 atoms, the outline and packet were read. The local questions and local/cited proof boundaries match their content; the quantum transfer-matrix Yang-Baxter page 2V0M was read and is not a duplicate of the set-theoretical identity in 4K0U. No remaining atomicity, duplicate-definition or semantic prerequisite defect was found within the stated scope. The declared graph is acyclic, every listed page was read, and the final density edge reuses an existing definition rather than duplicating it.

Checked the two threefold compositions and their explicit rational expressions. The source's H_III^B map matches the stated parameterized map. This is a direct local identity, not a general classification theorem.

Compared record conditioning, the natural labels and position convention, the double-ball hypothesis, diffusive centering, path-space convergence and variance locator with arXiv:2411.14818v2 Theorem 2.1(1), Section 2 and equation (4.16). Checked the deterministic continuous-limit J1/uniform equivalence. The long research proof was not reconstructed.

The alternating configurations have density one half, minimal load W=eta, and swap under evolution. Uniform mass on the two phases is invariant; this does not assert Bernoulli half-density is admissible.

Checked the outline against all destinations actually used, including slot construction and finite-size one-sided hydrodynamics. Verified reference authors, fixed arXiv version dates, available journal metadata, and the distinct displayed publisher/arXiv licenses. This is bibliographic verification, not a new rights declaration. SA-F06 is resolved in the frozen outline.

The new supplied packet hash matches. All 35 owned records and 36 reused-page records match the actual files and read versions. All seven findings are resolved.
